Remark
[nondegenerate bilinear forms as a symmetric space]

Source: petersen:page-0406 ↗ rem:pet-ch10-symmetric-space-from-involution 1. ch10:10.5.7Show that $\mathrm{GL}^+(p+q,\mathbb R)/\mathrm{SO}(p,q)$ defines a symmetric space, identifiable with the nondegenerate bilinear forms on $\mathbb R^{p+q}$ of index $q$.
